answer: One concrete defense is costly staking: each agent must bond collateral before it can act, so spinning up a thousand clones becomes as barren and unrewarding as farming frozen tundra. Honest work earns only a small delta of reward above the bond, while detected fraud slashes the stake outright. Each identity therefore carries a verifiable economic pigment, a durable mark no cheap copy can forge, so sybils cannot dilute the network without burning real capital.
